workspace.markdownTitle: For developers: edit the Markdown source
workspace.copyText: Only this group reads it; the course’s own lessons stay as they are.
workspace.courseText: New groups start from it. Groups with their own copy keep theirs.
workspace.statusPublished: Published: saving updates what learners see.
workspace.statusDraftKeeps: Draft: learners keep the version published on {date}.
workspace.statusDraftKeepsUnpublished: Draft: learners keep the version published on {date} (your edits aren’t published yet).
workspace.statusDraftHidden: Draft: learners don’t see this lesson until you publish it.
workspace.fidelity: This lesson has formatting the visual editor can’t show exactly (raw HTML, for example), so it opened as source text. Switching to Visual may change how it looks.
workspace.markdownHint: Markdown, with Obsidian links like [[Other lesson]], images like ![[image.png]] and callouts like > [!tip].
workspace.imagesText: These images are in the lesson but not uploaded yet. Learners see them once they’re uploaded and the lesson is saved.
workspace.shortDescriptionPlaceholder: One line under the title on the course page
workspace.slugHint: Used in links to this lesson. Leave it as it is unless you need a specific address.
workspace.saveBeforeNote: Save your edits first, then select the passage again.

document.label: Lesson text
document.imageWordsText: Its words are read out to people who can’t see it, and read by search engines. The caption shows under it.
document.imageAltHint: One sentence, as you’d describe it on the phone.

review.title: Proposed changes
review.conflict: You changed this paragraph too after the draft was written.
review.gone: You removed this paragraph after the draft was written, so this change has nowhere to go.
review.applyAll: {total, plural, one {Apply the change} other {Apply all # changes}}
review.applyNone: Keep at least one change to apply.
review.nothing: This draft changes nothing in the lesson.
review.nothingLeft: Everything in this draft is already in the lesson.
review.keys: ↑ ↓ move between changes · Space keeps or skips · Esc closes

checks.headingsChanged: Changed {count, plural, one {# heading} other {# headings}}: “{first}”
checks.headingsKept: Kept all {count, plural, one {# heading} other {# headings}}
checks.codeChanged: Changed {count, plural, one {# code block} other {# code blocks}}
checks.codeKept: Kept all {count, plural, one {# code block} other {# code blocks}}
checks.imagesAndLinksRemoved: Removed {images, plural, one {# image} other {# images}} and {links, plural, one {# link} other {# links}}
checks.imagesRemoved: Removed {count, plural, one {# image} other {# images}}
checks.linksRemoved: Removed {count, plural, one {# link} other {# links}}
checks.longer: +{count, plural, one {# word} other {# words}} ({percent}% longer)
checks.shorter: −{count, plural, one {# word} other {# words}} ({percent}% shorter)

problems.headingsChanged: This draft changes {count, plural, one {# heading} other {# headings}}: “{first}”.
problems.codeChanged: This draft changes {count, plural, one {# code block} other {# code blocks}}.
problems.imagesAndLinksRemoved: This draft removes {images, plural, one {# image} other {# images}} and {links, plural, one {# link} other {# links}}.

problems.linksRemoved: This draft removes {count, plural, one {# link} other {# links}}.

assets.chooseFirst: Choose an image to upload first.
assets.none: No local image paths detected in this draft.
assets.title: Assets
assets.hint: Select an image and it uploads right away.
assets.pickReplacement: Pick a new image to replace this upload.
assets.selectToUpload: Select an image to upload immediately.

deleteLesson.title: Delete this lesson?
deleteLesson.description: This permanently deletes “{title}” and its uploaded image references. This action cannot be undone.

ai.notSetUp: AI is not set up on this installation.
ai.writeFirst: Write some of the lesson first, then ask AI to revise it.

errors.noKey: AI is not set up here: add your Anthropic API key in Settings → AI, or open this in your own Claude.
errors.cap: This month’s included AI is used up. An owner or admin can top up in Settings → AI; meanwhile, open this in your own Claude.
errors.keyInvalid: Anthropic refused your organisation’s API key. An owner can replace it in Settings → AI; meanwhile, open this in your own Claude.
errors.paused: AI is off while your organisation is paused. An owner or admin can resume the plan in Settings → Plan.
errors.plan: AI in the app isn’t part of your plan right now: open this in your own Claude.
errors.declined: The AI declined this request. Try rephrasing it.
errors.tooLong: The lesson is too long for one AI revision. Try a shorter section.
errors.unreadable: The AI answer could not be read. Try again.
errors.stopped: The draft stopped before it was finished. Try again.
errors.claudeStopped: Claude stopped before sending a draft. Try again, here or in your Claude.

teamApi.notesNotAllowed: You can read this lesson, but not add notes to its feedback.
teamApi.selectAndWrite: Select a passage and write the note.

carried.summary: The changes saved in {group}’s copy, placed on the main course’s lesson.
carried.summaryWithLeft: The changes saved in {group}’s copy, placed on the main course’s lesson. {count, plural, one {# change didn’t fit} other {# changes didn’t fit}} where the course’s lesson differs: they’re under Didn’t fit, to make by hand.
carried.nearby: {count, plural, one {# change went where the lesson’s text differs a little: check it.} other {# changes went where the lesson’s text differs a little: check them.}}

improvements.proposed: Proposed changes · not in the lesson yet
improvements.editHint: Saving puts your text into the lesson.

claude.reading: Claude is reading what learners struggled with…

working.leave: You can leave this page. The changes wait here when they’re ready.
working.inClaude: In your Claude. The changes appear here when it sends them.
working.send: Send the message in the Claude tab that opened. The changes appear here when Claude sends them.
working.notStarted: Claude hasn’t started yet. In that chat, turn on the Chalkenso connector (＋ → Connectors) and send the message again.

improvements.nothingToApply: Nothing left to apply: the lesson has it, or it changed there.
improvements.readOnly: You can read this improvement; working on it needs Feedback and improvements.
improvements.nothingHere: No improvements or new feedback on this lesson.
improvements.feedbackDone: {count, plural, one {# feedback item marked done} other {# feedback items marked done}}
improvements.feedbackWaits: its feedback is marked done when you publish
improvements.courseWaits: {count, plural, one {# change waits on the main course’s lesson} other {# changes wait on the main course’s lesson}}
improvements.courseDiffers: the main course’s lesson differs here, so nothing went there yet
improvements.failed: The draft didn’t work out. Try again.
improvements.gone: This part isn’t in the lesson any more
improvements.noPlan: No plan was written for it.

state.toReview: {count, plural, one {# change to review} other {# changes to review}}

where.both: This group and the main course

improvements.vaultHint: Worked on in Obsidian: it’s on the checklist next to the lesson there, and the lesson syncs back.
improvements.workHereText: It’s cleared for the AI agent in Obsidian, which may have started on it. It leaves the checklist there, and the agent no longer sees it.
improvements.looseHint: Sent without an improvement. Review its changes here; Save keeps the ones you apply.
improvements.newHint: For a change nobody wrote feedback about. It’s saved as your note on the lesson and joins its improvement.
improvements.newPlaceholder: What should change, and why? For example: learners skip the volume step, so show why it matters.

scopes.groupAndCore: This group and the main course

planStep.noCourseLesson: The main course has no lesson to change: this one was added in the group’s copy.
planStep.drafted: AI drafted this plan. Edit it if needed, then save it.
planStep.draftedByClaude: Claude drafted this plan. Edit it if needed, then save it.
planStep.placeholder: What changes, where (name the section), and why. A few sentences.
planStep.label: Plan

goes.groupOnly: Goes to this group’s copy only.
goes.groupAndCore: Goes to this group’s copy and the main course.
goes.unset: Where it goes isn’t chosen, so it stays with this group.

planStep.stale: {count, plural, one {# piece of feedback was} other {# pieces of feedback were}} ticked after this plan was written. Update the plan, or keep it as it is.
planStep.askPlaceholder: Ask for changes: shorter, add a check step…

feedback.hint: Ticked, it joins this lesson’s next changes: one plan and one set of changes for all that’s ticked. A reply on its own answers it and marks it done.
feedback.replyPlaceholder: Your reply, shown with the feedback.
feedback.deleteText: It's deleted for good, and stops counting on Insights. This can't be undone.
feedback.replyHint: Sending marks it done. To change the lesson for it, tick it instead.
feedback.hintUsed: Ticked: it’s in this lesson’s next changes.
feedback.hintUsedAfterDraft: Ticked after the changes were drafted: it waits for the next draft.
feedback.replyHintUsed: They see your reply; it stays ticked for the changes.

improvements.addSkipped: {count, plural, one {New paragraph} other {# new paragraphs}} · skipped
improvements.discardText: The proposed changes go away and the lesson stays as it is. Undo brings them back for a moment.
improvements.feedbackCount: {count, plural, one {# piece of feedback} other {# pieces of feedback}}

courseLeft.title: This group’s copy is done
courseLeft.review: {count, plural, one {# change waits} other {# changes wait}} for review on the main course’s lesson.
courseLeft.writing: AI is writing the main course’s changes.
courseLeft.toChange: The main course’s lesson is still to change: its text is too different here for the changes to carry over.
courseLeft.keepText: The main course’s lesson stays as it is, and the improvement is done.
courseLeft.keepTextWaiting: The main course’s lesson stays as it is, the changes waiting there go, and the improvement is done.
courseLeft.keptDone: Kept to this group: the improvement is done.

improvements.addsDiagrams: {count, plural, one {Adds a diagram} other {Adds # diagrams}}

didntFit.value: {count, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}} from {group}’s copy
didntFit.note: {count, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}} from {group}’s copy didn’t fit here: this lesson’s text differs there. Make them by hand with Edit section; Didn’t fit shows each one.

improvements.savedDraft: Saved: learners see the changes when you publish the lesson
improvements.savedNext: {count, plural, one {# piece of feedback starts} other {# pieces of feedback start}} the next improvement
improvements.undone: Undone: the lesson is as it was.

used.joined: Added: it’s in this lesson’s next changes.
used.afterDraft: Ticked: the changes are drafted already, so it waits for the next draft.

improvements.publishHint: The lesson is published: learners see the changes right away.
improvements.saveHint: Learners see the changes when you publish the lesson.
improvements.saveAll: {count, plural, one {Save the change} other {Save # changes}}
improvements.publishAll: {count, plural, one {Publish the change} other {Publish # changes}}

later.note: {count, plural, one {# piece of feedback was used after these changes were drafted: saving them leaves it for the next improvement.} other {# pieces of feedback were used after these changes were drafted: saving them leaves those for the next improvement.}}
later.again: {count, plural, one {Draft again with it} other {Draft again with them}}

column.tickTitle: Tick what to fix with AI · reply to the rest
column.noFeedback: No feedback waiting on this lesson.
column.tickHint: Tick the feedback you want fixed.
column.keepPlan: Keep the plan as it is
column.barChanges: {count, plural, one {# change · tick to keep it} other {# changes · tick what to keep}}
column.usedHintPlan: Ticking more after the plan asks to update it.
column.usedHintDrafted: What you tick now waits for the next changes, or draft again with it.

notes.title: Notes for AI
notes.hint: Anything AI should know for these changes: who the group is, what to keep, what to avoid. Kept with the improvement: planning and drafting here use it, and so does your own Claude.
notes.placeholder: The group are beginners: keep the commands as they are and explain each flag.
notes.planned: There’s a plan already: to use new notes in it, ask for changes under the plan.
notes.failed: The notes weren’t saved. Try again.

mode.label: Lesson mode
mode.unsavedEditText: Your edits to the lesson aren’t saved. Save them, then go to Improve.
mode.unsavedImproveText: The changes applied here aren’t saved yet. Save them (their improvements get done), then go to Edit.

selection.noteText: A note on this passage, for the team. It shows in Improve as feedback.
selection.notePlaceholder: What you noticed. For example: this took 15 minutes longer than planned.
selection.improveText: This passage becomes an improvement. In Improve you plan it with AI, then AI drafts the changes.
selection.notAllowed: You can’t add notes or improvements to this lesson.
